characters.name: Vesle Aase Gaasepige
characters.prompt: A small, humble Norwegian goose girl from the 1400-1850s, wearing a simple, patched dress and a headscarf. She has a determined expression and carries a small sewing kit or a piece of cloth she is mending. Geese wander around her feet on a rustic Norwegian farmyard.

characters.name: The English Prince
characters.prompt: A regal young man from 1400-1850s England, with a confident posture and fine clothing in rich fabrics. He wears a small crown-like headdress or a decorative hat. The style echoes medieval or early modern royal fashion, featuring a sword at his side to symbolize status.

characters.name: First Princess
characters.prompt: A finely dressed princess from 1400-1850s Europe, wearing elegant but slightly conservative attire. She appears hesitant and worried, hinting at secrets in her past. The dress has embroidery and lace details, reflecting royal status of the era.

characters.name: Second Princess
characters.prompt: Another noble princess from 1400-1850s Europe, with a more lavish and ornate gown. She exudes a look of pride that masks her anxieties, wearing jewels in her hair and a richly colored cloak. Subtle hints of more worldly experience show in her posture.

characters.name: Third Princess
characters.prompt: A regal princess from 1400-1850s Europe, wearing an opulent dress with intricate patterns. She projects confidence and a certain cunning. Her hairstyle and accessories are notably grand, reflecting higher nobility, yet she also reveals a guarded demeanor.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a Norwegian countryside scene from the early 1400-1850s. Vesle Aase Gaasepige, dressed in simple layered woolen clothing, sits on a low stool mending patches, surrounded by geese. The English Prince arrives in stately medieval attire, while three other princesses in regal dresses stand off to one side, each looking uncertain. Show the old wooden farm buildings and distant mountains in the background, capturing the rustic yet royal atmosphere of the folktale.
modernMainImagePrompt: Portray a contemporary re-imagining of Vesle Aase Gaasepige and the English Prince. Aase is now a determined farmhand managing geese near a modern Norwegian barn. She wears practical jeans and a sweater with patches, while the Prince arrives in a sleek business suit, carrying an air of sophisticated urban style. Three fashionably dressed women watch in the background, each with distinct modern glamour, symbolizing the updated princesses.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a bright, friendly illustration for small children. Show Vesle Aase with a cheerful smile, tending to her fluffy white geese in a sunny meadow. The Prince appears kindly and curious, wearing a shining crown and a cape. Three princesses in colorful dresses stand by, each smiling but looking a bit worried. Use soft colors and rounded shapes for a warm, storybook style.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et bilde fra en norsk gård i gammeldags stil der Vesle Aase Gaasepike syr lapper og passer på gjessene sine. Prinsens kongelige antrekk skiller seg ut mot de enkle omgivelsene. Tre prinsesser står i bakgrunnen i flotte kjoler, men ser urolige ut. Bruk en lett, moderne norsk språkstil i beskrivelsen av motivet, og vis tydelig kontrast mellom Aases enkle klær og prinsens pyntede klesdrakt.
englishMainImagePrompt: Depict a rustic Norwegian scene set in the 1400-1850s, featuring Vesle Aase Gaasepige mending patches while tending her geese. The scenery should include an old timber farmhouse and rolling hills in the background. The English Prince, in regal attire of the era, approaches her with curiosity, while the three elegantly clad princesses stand by in slight discomposure. Maintain the original folktale's traditional charm and storytelling atmosphere.
